Name: Egg Festival Sell Crops
Author: GreenPlayer20
Description:
[size=5][b]Egg Festival Sell Crops[/b][/size]
In vanilla Stardew Valley, nothing can be sold to Pierre during festivals. That is a problem on Spring 13, potatoes harvested that day can only be shipped overnight, so the gold arrives after the Egg Festival is over and you can't spend it on strawberry seeds.

This small mod lets Pierre's Egg Festival booth buy your crops. Harvest in the morning, sell at the booth, and buy strawberry seeds with the money.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Sell vegetables and fruit at Pierre's Egg Festival booth.[/*]
[*]Optional config to also sell flowers, or flowers and forage.[/*]
[*]No code. It only edits the booth's shop data.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Unzip into your Mods folder and launch the game.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Edit config.json (created on first launch) or use Generic Mod Config Menu.
[list]
[*][b]SellCategories[/b]: Crops (default), CropsAndFlowers, or CropsFlowersAndForage[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Tested with a modded game on Spring 13. Mods that replace or edit the Egg Festival shop may override this. If the booth doesn't take crops, check the SMAPI log for a Content Patcher error about the shop ID.
